t: Lesson 9, Automation. Your instructor is Patrick Diamitani. If you do it every week, Claude can do it on a schedule.
There are two ways to put work on a schedule. Routines run in Anthropic's cloud, even with your laptop closed.
Scheduled tasks run on your computer through the app. Type slash schedule or use the scheduled sidebar.
And you set it up in plain English. Every Monday at 8, build a competitive brief and save it to this project.
Here are four to start with. A weekly competitor roundup, a daily pipeline snapshot, a monthly campaign rollup, and meeting prep built from your calendar every morning.
Make it stick. Pick one job you repeat. Ask for it in plain English. Review the first run closely. Then tweak it and let it run.
Quick recap. Routines and scheduled tasks turn your weekly chores into work that runs itself. Your mission, schedule one weekly task that saves you at least an hour.
Your busy work now runs itself. Last lesson. Stay safe at work and turn this into a career advantage. Learn, build, ship with LetsVibeAI
